title: Poetry: connecting literature to real life
canonical_examples_source: Language rules self-verified; format ref: bank uk-ks2-2024-gps (KS2 GPS).

blocks.content: The best reading happens when a poem or story connects to something you know. Making connections helps you understand and remember what you read.
A text-to-self connection links what you read to your own life and experiences.

steps: A poem describes a child missing a friend who moved away.
You remember when you changed schools and missed your friends.

blocks.question: A poem about a first day at a new school reminds you of your own first day. This is a:
blocks.explain: It links the text to your own experience, so it is a text-to-self connection.
blocks.rule: A text-to-self connection links a text to your own life and experiences.

practiceItems.prompt: linking a text to your own life is text-to-___
linking a text to the wider world is text-to-___
linking a text to another book is text-to-___

blocks.content: You can also connect a text to the wider world, or to another text you have read.

blocks.question: A poem about protecting the sea reminds you of a beach clean-up in your country. This is a:
blocks.explain: It links the poem to events in the wider world, so it is a text-to-world connection.
blocks.rule: A text-to-world connection links a text to events and issues in the wider world.

practiceItems.prompt: linking a poem to a real world event is text-to-___
linking two poems together is text-to-___
linking a text to your own memory is text-to-___
making connections helps you ___ what you read

blocks.question: A poem is about not giving up after failing a test. How does it connect to real life?
options: It reminds us to keep trying after we fail, like in our own lives
It has nothing to do with real life
Poems can never be about real things
blocks.explain: Connecting literature to life means linking the poem's message to your own experience. Everyone has failed at something, so a poem about not giving up speaks to real life — it encourages perseverance.
blocks.rule: Connect a text's message to your own real-life experience.
blocks.principle: Literature can mirror and guide real-life situations.
canonical_solution: The poem's message: keep trying after failing
Everyone fails sometimes in real life
So the message applies to us

misconceptions.coach: Failing and trying again is a real-life experience.
